name: After recital L
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: Ja. whereas the financing of public service media constitutes State aid within the meaning of Article 107(1) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and must comply with the principles laid down in the Commission communication on the application of State aid rules to public service broadcasting and the relevant case-law of the Court of Justice of the European Union, including the requirements of transparency, proportionality and effective public oversight;
